== 25% ==
Jim is 6 ft 3 inches tall and when his friend Erica stands on a stool which is one foot tall, she becomes 2 inches taller than him. How tall is Erica?

6 ft 3 plus 2 inches = 6 ft 5, then take away one foot for the stool = '''5 ft 5 inches'''.
